name: Vinh
provinceNote: Nghị quyết 1678/NQ-UBTVQH15, passed 16 June 2025, forms six wards — Trường Vinh, Thành Vinh, Vinh Hưng, Vinh Phú, Vinh Lộc, and Cửa Lò — with commune governments from 1 July 2025. An April 2025 council draft had called five of them Vinh I through Vinh V and kept Cửa Lò. The tourism pages still print tỉnh Nghệ An. From 1 December 2024 the former thị xã Cửa Lò is inside the city, printed as 166.22 km² and 580,669 people. Older pages print 105 km² and 438,796 people in 2008, 104.96 km², and more than 104 km² with more than 545,000 people.
dotReason: The sand at Cửa Lò and the square are worth a night
summary: Kim Lien, Ho Chi Minh’s home village, and the sand at Cua Lo. Walk the Ho Chi Minh square and the old citadel, then eat eel porridge. A beach day and a night in town, between Hanoi and Hue.
timeNeeded: A beach day and a night by the square
getThere: Sân bay Vinh is about 15 km out. Cửa Lò is 16, 17, 18, or about 20 km. Road minutes are check on arrival.
seoTitle: Vinh travel guide — Kim Lien and Cua Lo beach
seoDescription: Kim Lien is the home village outside the wards. Cua Lo is the sand. The square and the citadel are the evening in town.
intro: You wake on the sand at Cửa Lò, casuarina along đường Bình Minh, the water clear enough to see the sand. The city picture is Quảng trường Hồ Chí Minh and the statue at the corner of Hồ Tùng Mậu and Trường Thi. Kim Liên, outside the six wards, is the home village: 15 km on one account, 13 km by Quốc lộ 46 on the 2025 news page. Stay if the sand, that square, and Kim Liên are the trip. Go to Huế if the citadel is the trip. Go to Đồng Hới if Phong Nha is the next day.

The distances to the beach all stay. The national beach page prints 18 km and about 30 minutes by car on the Núi Cấm road. The city portal prints 17 km. A 2012 tourism news page prints 16 km to the east. A 3 May 2025 news page prints about 20 km. Older pages still say thị xã Cửa Lò. From 1 December 2024 that former town is inside the city, and from 1 July 2025 the beach wards are phường Cửa Lò. Quảng trường Bình Minh is on this sand. It is not the square in town.

The evening in town is the walking loop by the square. The April 2022 reports name Friday and Saturday, 19:00–23:30, on Hồ Tùng Mậu, Nguyễn Văn Cừ, Nguyễn Trung Ngạn, and Nguyễn Tài, about 1.5 km. Hồ Tùng Mậu is 430 m in those reports, Nguyễn Văn Cừ is 500 m, and Nguyễn Văn Cừ is the sidewalk of food shops and cafes. An English report of the same opening adds Sunday and names Nguyễn Trãi instead of the last two streets, and prints the fountain at nearly 1,000 m². A 2026 confirmation of which nights still close was not opened. In summer the other evening is the sand. The two evenings are not one street. No bar street was named.

The citadel is a gate, a moat the city roundup calls a lit lake with a grass bank, and the yard. It is not a reconstructed palace. Earth in 1804 under Gia Long, stone in Minh Mạng’s 12th year, 1831. The Xô viết museum is in that yard, nearly 2 km from the square, with more than 5,000 objects. Núi Quyết holds the Quang Trung temple, 92 m above the sea, where the 1 October 1788 edict sited Phượng Hoàng Trung Đô. The city page says that capital was started and not finished. Kim Liên is outside the six wards: 15 km on the city portal, 13 km by Quốc lộ 46 on the 2025 news page.
gettingAround: Sân bay Vinh is about 15 km from the center on the national tourism page, which names flights to Hà Nội, Đà Nẵng, and Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh. The city portal names those three plus Buôn Ma Thuột and Đà Lạt, and names Vietnam Airlines, Jetstar Pacific, and Vietjet, with 22 movements a day on that page. Both route lists stay. The Jetstar Pacific name is what that portal page prints. A terminal address, a phone, a block time, and any kilometre besides the 15 km figure were not on the pages that loaded.

Ga Vinh is on the north–south line. The national page says every through train stops here. The city portal prints 319 km from Ga Hà Nội, and the Vietnam Railways southbound sheet also prints Vinh at km 319. A timetable collected on 15 Oct 2026 prints 321 km from Hanoi. Keep 319 and 321. The city portal’s “about five and a half hours” by rail from Hà Nội is that page’s phrase. It is not the same figure as the clocks. NA1 departs Hà Nội at 22:45 and arrives Vinh at 05:35. NA2 leaves Vinh at 21:30 and reaches Hà Nội at 05:05. Those are the daily pair for trains leaving 17 August through 30 December 2026. Fares were not copied. Southbound cells on the railways sheet: SE7 11:59, SE5 13:49, SE9 19:02, SE3 01:00 the next day, SE1 03:28 the next day. SE7 continues to Đồng Hới 16:27, Huế 19:43, and Đà Nẵng 22:30. The 15 October 2026 departure list also prints SE8 10:12 Hanoi, SE6 12:35 Hanoi, SE10 20:33 Hanoi, SE4 22:27 Hanoi, SE2 23:08 Hanoi, SE20 04:35 Hanoi, SE19 01:29 Da Nang, and SE32 Friday only 02:04 Hanoi. Northbound Vinh-to-Huế cells were not in the portion of the official sheet that loaded. These are scheduled times, not live tracking.

By road the national page prints 291 km to Hà Nội, 1,418 km to Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, and 452 km to Đà Nẵng. The city portal prints 295 km to Hà Nội, 1,424 km to Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, and 400 km to Viêng Chăn. Keep both Hà Nội figures and both Hồ Chí Minh City figures. Quốc lộ 1A through the city is 10 km on the national page and 15 km on the city portal. Two city bus lines run toward the beach: Bến Thủy–Trường Thi–Cửa Hội–Cửa Lò, and Bến Thủy–Quang Trung–Quán Bánh–Cửa Lò. The city portal names Bến xe Vinh and Bến xe Chợ Vinh, and says Bắc Vinh and Nam Vinh were being built. That page does not give a 2026 bay. On site, the square is the walk in the center. The four beach distances above are the ones to use. Do not collapse them.

stayAreas.name: Bình Minh
stayAreas.summary: Sleep along đường Bình Minh when the day is the swim. The national beach page puts the sand and the casuarina on this road. No hotel brand is a pick.

stayAreas.name: By the square
stayAreas.summary: A city room within a walk of Quảng trường Hồ Chí Minh when the night is the walking loop. The square is at Hồ Tùng Mậu and Trường Thi. No hotel brand is a pick.

eat: Cháo lươn is the thin porridge the city page describes: the rice cooked as whole grains, a little sticky rice so it stays silky, the eel seasoned, stir-fried, and folded in rather than boiled to pieces. Pepper, chili, and herbs go on at the table, with bánh mì or bánh mướt. The same page sets it beside thicker bowls it names as cháo vịt Vân Đình and cháo dê Ninh Bình, and says the bowl shows itself in cool weather. A 24-hour city page treats it as the bowl that means you have arrived, any meal. Súp lươn is the other eel bowl. A 2025 page says the eel is small field eel, soaked in rice water, blanched, pulled off the bone, and stir-fried with shallot, turmeric, and chili, and that the bones are crushed for the broth. It starts the day with that bowl. Hồ Sỹ Dương is the night stretch a Nghệ An news page names for xôi, cháo gà, cháo lươn, and miến ngan. No stall price is printed.

Breakfast is bánh mướt with giò lụa or chả, or xôi, or a hot bowl of cháo canh if you do not want a dry one. The city page describes bánh mướt Diễn Châu as finger-length rolls, soft and translucent, rice flour only, fried shallot inside, eaten with nước mắm, lime, and fresh chili, or beside grilled meat at lunch. Diễn Châu is another commune. The sheet is eaten here. Mực nhảy and mực câu are the beach squid the national beach page names. Ask for charcoal, and for mực một nắng when you want the dried-one-day squid. A 2025 page also names it steamed. Cam Vinh is the fruit the national page names beside the eel. Cà phê bọt has been poured in Chợ Vinh for more than 30 years, black or with milk, the foam drunk first or stirred in. Mía hấp gừng is the cool or wet weather sweet. Tuổi Trẻ, 5 April 2022, says the 2019 Cao Thắng night market in front of Chợ Vinh stopped after a few months. Báo Nghệ An, 27 April 2023, still names phố đêm Cao Thắng as a night-economy project. Do not treat the 2019 market as open.

The city introduction also sets canh hến and hến xúc bánh tráng on a summer lunch, chả rươi and mắm rươi in rươi season, nộm at the markets, nước chè xanh, and kẹo cu đơ. The same introduction traces the candy to a maker from Hương Sơn. Đào Tấn is the citadel night street Báo Nghệ An described on 27 April 2023, from cửa Hữu to cửa Tả, with a second line of about 150 m. Mobile kiosks on that account run 18:00–06:00. Fixed kitchens were allowed 24 hours. A 2026 night list was not opened. Tương Nam Đàn, nhút Thanh Chương, and bánh đa Đô Lương are not stalls in the center.
interestsBody: The bowl is cháo lươn or súp lươn, and the morning sheet is bánh mướt. Hồ Sỹ Dương is the night stretch Báo Nghệ An names for xôi, cháo gà, cháo lươn, and miến ngan. Đào Tấn is the citadel night street, from cửa Hữu to cửa Tả on the 27 April 2023 account. Nguyễn Văn Cừ is the cafe and food sidewalk on the walking loop.

Cửa Lò is the beach of this city, along Bình Minh. The four distances stay: 16 km, 17 km, 18 km, and about 20 km. The evening on the sand is a separate night from the walking loop. No bar street was named.

The square, the citadel gate, and the Xô viết museum are the city walk. Núi Quyết is the temple and the view over sông Lam. Đền Hồng Sơn, chùa Diệc, and chùa Cần Linh are named in town. The walking loop is Friday and Saturday on the 2022 plan, with Sunday only on the English report. Confirm the night.

interestGroups.title: Dining and F&B
interestGroups.summary: Eel porridge in town, bánh mướt in the morning, and the Cửa Lò grill after dark.

cards.title: Dining and F&B
cards.summary: Cháo lươn, bánh mướt, and the night plates on the beach.

interestGroups.title: Beach day at Cửa Lò
interestGroups.summary: The sand of this city, along Bình Minh. Not a second destination.
body: Swim and walk a beach the national page calls long, with water clear enough to see the sand. Casuarina lines đường Bình Minh. The same page describes a summer southwest wind in the morning and a sea breeze later.

Keep every distance: 18 km and about 30 minutes by the Núi Cấm road, 17 km on the city portal, 16 km east on the 2012 page, and about 20 km on the 3 May 2025 page. For the 2025 season the city made showers, public toilets, parking, and wifi free. That sentence is the season, not a standing bylaw.

cards.title: Cua Lo beach
cards.summary: The sand, the tree line, and the water. Four distances stay.

interestGroups.title: The square and the citadel
interestGroups.summary: The 18 m statue, the Nguyễn gate, and the Xô viết museum in the yard.
body: Quảng trường Hồ Chí Minh is the city’s largest political and cultural open space, at Hồ Tùng Mậu and Trường Thi. The 2025 news page prints the statue at 18 m. No second height was loaded. The walking loop closes around it on the nights in the 2022 plan.

Thành cổ Vinh is a gate and a moat, not a palace. The city introduction prints a six-sided wall, perimeter 603 trượng (2,412 m), height 4.42 m, area 420,000 m², and a moat 28 m wide and 3.20 m deep. The museum in the yard is nearly 2 km from the square. Bảo tàng Quân khu IV is named on the national page. Its door was not confirmed.

cards.title: Ho Chi Minh Square
cards.summary: The full statue and the open square. 18 m on one page. No ticket was printed.

cards.title: Vinh Citadel
cards.summary: The gate and the yard. Earth in 1804, stone in 1831.

cards.title: Nghe Tinh Soviet Museum
cards.summary: In the citadel yard, nearly 2 km from the square. More than 5,000 objects.

interestGroups.title: The mountain over the Lam
interestGroups.summary: The Quang Trung temple on Núi Quyết, and the view toward sông Lam.
body: The temple is on the second summit, 92 m above the sea. The 1 October 1788 edict sited Phượng Hoàng Trung Đô here. The city page says that capital was started and not finished. The roundup says the management board receives more than 110,000 visits a year.

The two lunar days are the death anniversary on the 29th of the 7th lunar month and the Ngọc Hồi–Đống Đa anniversary on the 5th of the 1st lunar month. The solar date for a given year follows that lunar day.

cards.title: Quyet Mountain
cards.summary: The temple roof, then the city and sông Lam.

interestGroups.title: Shopping
interestGroups.summary: Chợ Vinh for the hall and the foam coffee. Chợ Ga and Chợ Quán Lau are named, not pictured.
body: The city portal lists Chợ Vinh, Chợ Ga Vinh, and Chợ Quán Lau as the large markets. The photograph here is the street front of Chợ Vinh, not the aisle. Cà phê bọt is poured in the hall, black or with milk.

The 2019 night market on Cao Thắng, in front of Chợ Vinh, stopped after a few months, on Tuổi Trẻ, 5 April 2022. Báo Nghệ An, 27 April 2023, still names phố đêm Cao Thắng as a night-economy project beside the walking street and the citadel food street. Do not treat the 2019 market as open. The undated city introduction also names large shops: Metro, Big C, Intimex, Maximax, Vạn Xuân, CK Palaza. The spelling is the introduction’s. A 2026 shop-front check was not done.

cards.title: Vinh Market
cards.summary: The street front of Chợ Vinh. The foam coffee is inside.

faqs.q: How far is Cửa Lò from Vinh?
faqs.a: Four figures stay. The national beach page prints 18 km and about 30 minutes by car on the Núi Cấm road. The city portal prints 17 km. A 2012 tourism news page prints 16 km east. A 3 May 2025 news page prints about 20 km. The other three pages do not print minutes.

faqs.q: Which airport serves Vinh, and how long is the flight?
faqs.a: Sân bay Vinh is about 15 km from the center on the national page. That page names Hà Nội, Đà Nẵng, and Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh. The city portal adds Buôn Ma Thuột and Đà Lạt. A block time, a terminal address, and any other kilometre were not loaded.

faqs.q: When does the walking street close to vehicles?
faqs.a: The April 2022 plan, quoted from the deputy chairman and repeated on 12 April 2022, is Friday and Saturday, 19:00–23:30, on Hồ Tùng Mậu, Nguyễn Văn Cừ, Nguyễn Trung Ngạn, and Nguyễn Tài. An English report of the same opening adds Sunday and names Nguyễn Trãi instead of the last two streets. A 2026 night list was not opened. The plan runs to 23:30.

season.label: Summer sea breeze
season.note: The national page prints a tropical monsoon climate, two seasons, average 24°C, humidity 85–90%, about 1,696 hours of sun, and about 2,000 mm of rain a year. The beach page says the summer southwest wind is light in the morning and the sea breeze takes over late in the day. A storm-month calendar was not on these pages. The Cửa Lò sea festival opened the evening of 19 April 2025 at Quảng trường Bình Minh. The 2026 date was not on the page. Hồng Sơn is the 3rd of the 3rd lunar month and the 20th of the 8th. Quang Trung days are the 29th of the 7th lunar month and the 5th of the 1st. The solar date for a given year follows that lunar day.
